sample_description: anodic TiO2 nanotube films on Ti (30 V, glycerol electrolyte; tubes ~1.06 um long, 89 nm inner diameter) (TNT) and cathodically self-doped TNT (SD-TNT, -1.5 V, 450 min), calcined 60 min at 450 or 550 C; 450 C films anatase only, 550 C films anatase + rutile (XRD)
conditions: calcined 450 °C or 550 °C, 60 min; SD-TNT self-doped at -1.5 V for 450 min
notes: paper: Eg; positions stated jointly for TNT and SD-TNT calcined at 450 and 550 C (one sentence, not per spectrum); all bands ~8-13 cm-1 below the usual anatase values, not discussed by the paper; the paper reports a blue shift of Eg(1) after self-doping but gives no numbers; the deconvolution paragraph calls it the Eg mode at ~135 cm-1
